title: Building my FinOS Cozy RPG in Public Week: 1
author: Worried_Number5115
selftext:
I’ve been building an IOS app in React Native (future plans for Android and web app) called Finance that is my way of reimagining gamefied finance

I created a Financial Operating system that turns your real financial life into an RPG with a tailored “Quest” system with step by steps details on your next wealth move, tailored to each player. 

The app includes a full financial education system (scrolls), Plaid account linking for deep financial management & tracking, a gamefied playable RPG that teaches financial education through every single one of its mechanics, from the economy to combat to dialogue. I wanted to create a really fun game that subtly teaches personal finance and allows you to play it out without lecturing. 

It’s been exactly 3 months since I started this project and it’s come and extremely long way. 

Check my website & a video in the comments if you want to learn more or signup for the waitlist! 

I have no scheduled release date for the app and my philosophy has shifted to simply taking my take and scoping each part of my builds before making changes in the app. I am willing to continue working on Forge no matter how long it takes, my priority is Quality, Craft, & value….NOT speed. 

Ask me anything about my process and I’d love to get criticism and feedback on the app.
